# VoidFrame UI

> Dark monochrome React UI framework. Terminal-brutalist. Data-dense. Zero border-radius. Monospace-first.

## Key Facts
- 500+ components, 76 hooks, 100 utilities
- React 18+ peer dependency
- TypeScript strict mode, full .d.ts declarations
- 4 built-in themes: dark, light, midnight, grey
- 10 locales with RTL support
- WAI-ARIA semantics + keyboard navigation on every interactive surface
- Tree-shakeable subpath exports: voidframe-ui/core, /forms, /data, /charts, etc.
- MIT licensed

## Links
- [Documentation](https://daxavalon.github.io/voidframe-ui/)
- [Full API Reference](https://daxavalon.github.io/voidframe-ui/llms-full.txt)
- [GitHub](https://github.com/DaxAvalon/voidframe-ui)

- [Utilities JSON](https://daxavalon.github.io/voidframe-ui/api/utils.json)

- ResizableBox: Resizable container with configurable handles. Emits `onResize({ width, height })`.

- ResizableHandle: Drag handle subpart for `ResizableGroup` / `ResizablePanel`. Keyboard-resizable with arrow keys.

- ScrollArea: Overflow container with CSS-only brutalist scrollbars. Native scrolling is preserved so keyboard, t…

- SplitView: Two-pane split view with a draggable divider. Controllable split ratio.
- Stack: Vertical or horizontal flex stack with a `gap` prop. Composable and responsive.
- Sticky: Wrapper that makes its child `position: sticky` with configurable offset and enabled breakpoints.
- Stretch: Inline filler for flex containers.
- VStack: Vertical stack — `flex-direction: column`, default align `stretch`.

### Animation
- Marquee: Scrolling marquee for long inline content. Respects `prefers-reduced-motion` and pauses on hover.
- Ticker: Auto-advancing horizontal ticker for news-style headlines. Respects `prefers-reduced-motion`.
- Typewriter: Types out a string character by character. Respects `prefers-reduced-motion` (renders immediately).

### Charts
- Arc: Arc series primitive for donut / pie / gauge charts. Plots a radial slice bound to a value range an…
- Area: Area series primitive for line/area charts. Fills between a baseline and a datum series using the e…
- AreaChart: Area chart over a shared X axis. Axes: linear or time (X), linear (Y). Interactions: hover crosshai…
- Axis: Chart axis primitive. Renders ticks, gridlines, and an axis label for the enclosing chart's X or Y …
- Bar: Bar series primitive. Draws rectangles for each datum using the enclosing chart's band/linear scale…
- BarChart: Vertical or horizontal bar chart (grouped, stacked, or 100%-stacked). Axes: band (category) x linea…
- BoxPlot: Box-and-whisker plot. Axes: band (category) x linear (value). Shows quartiles, median, whiskers, an…
- Brush: Chart brush primitive: a draggable window that scopes the visible domain. Emits `onChange(range)` f…
- BubbleChart: Alias — "BubbleChart" is just ScatterPlot with sizeRange used.
- BubbleMap: Geographic bubble map. Plots value-sized circles over a TopoJSON base map. Peer: `d3-geo` + `topojs…
- CalendarHeatmap: GitHub-style calendar heatmap. Bins values per day and shades cells by intensity; supports weekly o…
- CandlestickChart: OHLC candlestick chart. Axes: time x linear. Each datum is `{ date, open, high, low, close }`; wick…
- ChartFrame: Shared chart shell: handles dimensions, margins, ARIA role, and the internal context that series/ax…
- ChartLegend: Legend primitive for any chart. Maps series colour to label; clickable entries toggle series visibi…
- ChartScales: Re-publishes ChartContext with the provided scales merged in. Inner-chart components (AreaChartInne…
- ChartTooltip: Positioned tooltip primitive for charts. Reads the current hovered datum from chart context and ren…
- ChartTooltipBody: Uniform layout for every chart's hover readout.
- ChordDiagram: Circular chord diagram showing weighted relationships between categories. Matrix-in, arcs-out layou…
- ChoroplethMap: Geographic choropleth. Fills regions in a TopoJSON base map by value. Peer: `d3-geo` + `topojson-cl…
- ComposedChart: Composition chart — combine bars, lines, areas, and reference layers over shared axes. Axes: linear…
- Crosshair: Chart crosshair primitive: follows the pointer with vertical/horizontal rule lines and highlights t…
- DependencyGraph: Directed graph of dependencies with hierarchical layout. Useful for module / package / task graphs.
- DonutChart: Donut (hollow pie) chart for part-of-whole data. Emits hover/select events per slice and supports a…
- FunnelChart: Funnel / conversion chart — each stage is a trapezoid sized by value. Shows drop-off between adjace…
- Gridlines: Chart gridlines primitive. Renders horizontal/vertical rules tied to tick positions of the enclosin…
- Heatmap: Two-dimensional heatmap. Axes: band x band. Cells shade by intensity; tooltip exposes raw value.
- Histogram: Binned frequency chart. Axes: linear (bin) x linear (count). Configurable bin count or explicit thr…
- HorizonChart: Horizon chart: stacked banded areas that encode large dynamic ranges compactly. Good for many time-…
- Line: Line series primitive for line / area / composed charts. Connects points from the enclosing chart's…
- LineChart: Line chart over a shared X axis. Axes: linear or time (X), linear (Y). Interactions: hover crosshai…
- NetworkGraph: Force-directed graph. Nodes relax via d3-force; drag a node to pin it. Peer: `d3-force`.
- OHLCChart: Alias — OHLC is the tick-style variant.
- OrgChart: Top-down hierarchical chart (e.g. org structure). Collapsible subtrees and pan/zoom.
- ParallelCoordinates: Parallel-coordinates chart for high-dimensional data. One vertical axis per dimension; polylines co…
- PieChart: Pie chart for part-of-whole data. For a hollow centre slot see `DonutChart`.
- Point: Point (scatter) series primitive. Plots individual `{ x, y }` marks using the enclosing chart's sca…
- RadarChart: Radar / spider chart for multi-axis categorical data. Each ring is a value level; axes radiate from…
- ReferenceBand: Chart primitive: coloured band spanning a value range on an axis. Good for thresholds / SLAs.
- ReferenceLine: Chart primitive: dashed rule at a reference value on an axis. Optional label.
- Sankey: Sankey flow diagram. Weighted links between nodes; auto-layout via `d3-sankey` (peer).
- ScatterMatrix: Scatterplot matrix: small-multiples grid pairing every dimension against every other.
- ScatterPlot: Scatter plot for two numeric dimensions. Axes: linear x linear. Optional `sizeRange` turns it into …
- SmallMultiples: Grid of small charts sharing encoding / scale. Good for comparing many categories at once.
- Sparkline: Tiny inline trend chart. No axes / labels — context comes from the surrounding content.
- StreamGraph: Stream graph (river plot) for stacked time-series. Visually emphasises category flow over time.
- Sunburst: Radial hierarchical chart (zoomable). Peer: `d3-hierarchy`.
- TileGridMap: Built-in US-states layout (postal code keys). Source: standard "tile grid" arrangement used by Five…
- TreeMap: Hierarchical rectangle tiling weighted by value. Peer: `d3-hierarchy`.
- ViolinPlot: Violin plot (density + box combined). Axes: band x linear.
- WaterfallChart: Waterfall chart showing running totals with positive/negative contributions. Axes: band x linear.

- Zoomable: Wrapper that makes a child pan + zoomable (pinch / wheel / drag). Emits the current transform.
